meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 装上后,当用户请求报告 bug 时,Claude 会先调查问题、对比最新源代码,判断缺陷属于 LazyCodex 还是上游 Codex,然后生成一份带证据的 GitHub issue(或 PR),包含复现步骤、根因、修复建议等,并自动加上指定标签和页脚。
howto.when: 当用户要求报告、提交或分类 LazyCodex、Codex 插件或上游 Codex CLI 的 bug 时触发,尤其在需要根因和修复指引时。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 报个 bug,附上复现步骤。
say.note: 会先调查并定位到正确仓库再创建 issue。

say.text: 把这个问题归档到 openai/codex 并开一个 issue。
say.note: 只在确认是上游 Codex 缺陷时这么做。

say.text: 调查这个 Codex 插件崩溃的根因,然后创建 issue。
say.note: 会先拉取最新源码对照证据。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude investigates the reported bug, compares latest source code to decide whether it belongs to LazyCodex or upstream Codex, then generates a GitHub issue or PR backed by evidence, including reproduction steps, root cause, fix guidance, and required label/footer.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI.

say_en.text: File a bug for LazyCodex with reproduction steps.
say_en.note: It will investigate and route to the right repo.

say_en.text: Open an issue in openai/codex for this problem.
say_en.note: Only if it reproduces in clean upstream Codex.

say_en.text: Investigate this Codex plugin crash and create an issue.
say_en.note: It will verify against latest source first.
